name: How should homeowners prepare before a kitchen tile installation begins?

mainEntity.name: How should homeowners prepare before a kitchen tile installation begins?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before kitchen tile installers arrive, you should clear the workspace to prevent delays and protect your belongings. Clear all items off countertops and move freestanding appliances like refrigerators or ranges out of the kitchen if agreed upon in your contract scope. Remove rugs, pet bowls, and trash cans, and clear an access path through doorways and hallways for tools and materials. It is also wise to identify shutoff valves for the refrigerator water line and stove connections beforehand in case disconnecting appliances becomes necessary during the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear all floor items, empty countertops, disconnect and relocate appliances if scheduled, and ensure installers have an unobstructed path into the kitchen.
